name: Saurav Khanal
title: Software Engineer
bio: Software engineer building reliable, high-performance systems for the web. Focused on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, and database systems.

about.summary: I am a computer engineer based in Nepal building full-stack and data-intensive applications. I focus on developing reliable software end-to-end, from responsive user interfaces to robust backend APIs and efficient database systems.

about.current: Currently engineering production systems at GritFeat Solutions, building full-stack and data-driven applications with TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Azure.

experience.description: Building full-stack web applications and backend services. Developing robust APIs with JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js, managing MongoDB and SQL database systems, and integrating cloud services on Azure.

Leading digital infrastructure and web platforms for the non-profit. Managing email systems, DNS records, website deployments, and digital resources supporting educational initiatives across rural Nepal.
Completed intensive engineering fellowship developing responsive web applications, component libraries, and API integrations with React, Express, and TypeScript.
